item.title: Fisherman details moment boat capsized near Tomales Bay, rescue that followed
item.description: "When I knew the boat was sinking, I tried to get life jacket on, it's too late for me, the boat flipped over. I grabbed the boat," said Minh Nguyen, one of the three fishermen rescued from the waters near Tomales Bay.

item.title: Judge dismisses case against ex-cop accused of killing Steven Taylor at San Leandro Walmart
item.description: On Friday, a judge in Alameda County dismissed a case against a former San Leandro police officer who killed a man inside a Walmart five years ago.

item.title: Late San Francisco Mayor Ed Lee honored at City Hall with new bust
item.description: "People's Mayor": On Friday, the bust of James Phelan, a former mayor who promoted his anti-Chinese views, was replaced with that of the city's first Asian American Mayor, Ed Lee.

item.title: Arctic air plunges south as residents of the Pacific Northwest remain on guard after severe flooding
item.description: A blast of arctic air is plunging south from Canada and spreading into parts of the northern U.S., while residents of the Pacific Northwest brace for possible mudslides and levee failures from floodwaters that are expected to be slow to recede.

item.title: Residents report cracks on ceiling, walls after massive explosion shakes Hayward neighborhood
item.description: Residents of the unincorporated Hayward neighborhood are still shaken and uncertain if their homes are safe, with some relocating for now.

item.title: 'Avatar: Fire and Ash': Behind the scenes with James Cameron, Zoe Saldaña and more!
item.description: "Avatar: Fire and Ash" opens in theaters Dec. 19, and On The Red Carpet is taking you inside the making of the film with James Cameron and the film's all-star cast.

item.title: Peter Greene, a character actor known for role as the villain Zed in 'Pulp Fiction,' has died
item.description: In 1994, he played the memorable villain in Quentin Tarantino's "Pulp Fiction," who is brought in to torture characters played by Bruce Willis and Ving Rhames.

item.title: Former UC Berkeley quarterback Fernando Mendoza wins Heisman Trophy
item.description: Fernando Mendoza, the mercurial quarterback of No. 1 Indiana, won the Heisman Trophy on Saturday night. Mendoza played for Cal from 2022 to 2024 before transferring to Indiana in 2025.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Chilly, areas of dense fog overnight
item.description: Widespread areas of fog will return overnight, with low temperatures ranging generally from upper 30s inland to lower 40s near the coast and bay.

item.title: 2 killed, 9 hurt in Brown University shooting; video of suspected shooter released amid manhunt
item.description: A shelter-in-place order remains in effect for the greater Brown University area, officials said on Saturday night.
